name: web-prototype-taste-brutalist
summary: Swiss industrial-print web prototype. Newsprint canvas, monolithic black grotesque, viewport-bleeding numerals, hairline grid dividers, hazard-red accent, ASCII syntax decoration. Distilled from Leonxlnx/taste-skill `brutalist-skill` (Swiss Industrial Print mode).

name: contact-widget
summary: Self-contained floating chat widget with welcome screen, social links, meeting button, and message input. Single HTML file, zero dependencies.

name: html-ppt-taste-editorial
summary: 16:9 HTML deck in editorial-minimalist taste. Warm cream slides, serif display + grotesque body, hairline rules, monospace meta, generous macro-whitespace, one accent. Distilled from Leonxlnx/taste-skill `minimalist-skill`.

name: web-prototype-taste-editorial
summary: Editorial-minimalist web prototype. Warm monochrome canvas, serif display + grotesque body, 1px hairline borders, muted pastel chips, generous macro-whitespace, ambient micro-motion. Distilled from Leonxlnx/taste-skill `minimalist-skill`.

name: web-prototype-taste-soft
summary: Apple-tier soft web prototype. Silver/cream canvas, double-bezel cards, button-in-button CTAs, generous squircle radii, spring motion, ambient mesh. Distilled from Leonxlnx/taste-skill `soft-skill` + sections 4–8 of `taste-skill`.

name: token-map
summary: Map an extracted Figma / source-code token bag onto the active OD design system, producing a deterministic mapping the generate stage can consume.

name: html-ppt-taste-brutalist
summary: 16:9 HTML deck in tactical-telemetry / CRT-terminal taste. Deactivated-CRT charcoal slides, white-phosphor monospace, hazard-red accent, scanline overlay, ASCII syntax, density over decoration. Distilled from Leonxlnx/taste-skill `brutalist-skill` (Tactical Telemetry mode).

name: critique-theater
summary: Five-role Design Jury review that streams scored rounds, persists a replayable transcript, and ships through the daemon's Critique Theater protocol.

name: todo-write
summary: TodoWrite-driven plan that the agent commits to before generation.

name: article-magazine
summary: Huashu / huashu-md-html-inspired magazine article layout for turning Markdown or notes into a polished long-form HTML essay.

name: discovery-question-form
summary: Structured clarification form for unresolved material requirements.

name: design-extract
summary: Extract design tokens (color / typography / spacing) from imported source code, screenshots, or Figma exports into the canonical token bag token-map consumes.

name: handoff
summary: Push the run's accepted artifact to a downstream collaboration surface (cli, other code agents, cloud, desktop) and stamp the artifact manifest with the export target.

name: patch-edit
summary: Apply one rewrite-plan step at a time as small reviewable file edits, never rewriting whole files when a localised change suffices.

name: card-twitter
summary: Twitter quote or data card designed to pair with a post.

name: card-xiaohongshu
summary: Xiaohongshu-style knowledge cards, arranged as a swipeable multi-card carousel.

name: sample-plugin
summary: Phase 1 sample plugin synthesizing a SKILL.md frontmatter for backwards-compat tests.

name: build-test
summary: Run the project's build / typecheck / lint / test commands and emit the build.passing + tests.passing signals devloop convergence reads.

name: code-import
summary: Read an existing repository's structure into the project cwd as a normalised snapshot the agent can analyse without re-walking the tree on every turn.

name: diff-review
summary: Render the patch-edit run's accumulated changes as a reviewable diff, surface it through a GenUI choice surface, and persist the user's accept / reject decision into the artifact manifest.

name: direction-picker
summary: Optional 3-5 direction picker for users who explicitly ask to compare visual directions.

name: figma-extract
summary: Pull a Figma file's node tree, design tokens, and embedded assets into the project cwd as a structured snapshot.

name: rewrite-plan
summary: Author a long-running multi-file rewrite plan that subsequent patch-edit + diff-review + build-test stages will execute, with explicit ownership boundaries and patch-safety guarantees.
